summary: 客户来索赔，怎么说、拿什么证据、赔多少，这课把整套英文应对话术和流程都给你捋顺了。
keypoints: 掌握索赔核心词汇：file a claim、accept a claim、reject a claim，张嘴就能用。
索赔前先备足理由和证据，substantial evidence 是索赔能不能成的关键。
谈解决方案时用 friendly solution 这类表达，既推进事情又不得罪客户。
学会算索赔金额和谈补偿，比如按总金额10%赔付的说法要会表达。
分清索赔和投诉不是一回事，处理时记得保留继续追偿的权利。

title: 99_第6课基础实用商务英语：贸易往来（六）产品索赔_720p
readable: 大家好，我是Edan。现在我们来到了商务应用口语课程贸易往来环节的第六节课，关于产品的索赔。因为前面我们讲到了客户提出的质量异议，那么可能就会涉及到索赔了。索赔的话，不管是哪一方面的问题，我们都要尽可能地去处理这样的问题，展现出我们自己的一个职业素养。这个时候我们可能会说‘I have to file a claim with you for the loss’，或者客户会说‘I have to file a claim with you for the losses’。看一下当时的证据，也就是我们前文学到的proof，replacement，compare，substantial，Make a settlement，Amicably log a claim for the losses，Effect of poor settlement，Fire a claim with you，Reserve the right to do something，Fire a claim with somebody。这里就是像前面的‘Fire a claim with you’。Settlement of balance。接下来我们来看一些提出索赔的表达。‘We have lodged a complaint for inferior quality’‘We have lodged a complaint’‘Logged a complaint’‘For an inferior quality’‘There is a substantial evidence for lodging a complaint’‘I'll go to your company in person to talk about your complaint’‘We are not in a position to entertain your complaint’‘We are not in a position to entertain your complaint’。提出索赔要求了，接下来就是要说一下索赔的理由。理由要充分才能够得到索赔。‘The goods are much inferior in quality to that of your samples’‘The goods are of much inferior in quality to that of your samples’‘With reference to the damage of our goods, we claim a compensation of $70,000’‘We should lodge a complaint, a claim for the losses incurred as a consequence of your failure to ship our order in time’‘We regret to inform you that we will file a claim with you because of your underweight goods’‘We will inform you that we will file a claim with you because of your underweight goods’。接下来我们看一下一些必备的句子。对于索赔，我们应该接受还是拒绝呢？讨论解决方案的时候，我们会用到哪一些表达呢？这里我们来了解一下。‘Have you got any evidence?’‘We hope to resolve this issue’‘We hope to resolve this issue amicably’‘Our responsibility will affect our responsibility’‘We can only compensate 50% of the responsibility’‘We are ready to pay 50% of the loss only’。索赔的一些小词汇：Acept once claim，This means a claim，Reject a claim，Settle a claim，Withdraw a claim。接下来我们来看一下时间对话。‘Would you agree to replacement?’‘We will arrange replacement immediately’‘Represent’‘I'm sorry to have cost you some inconvenience with this shipment’‘I'm sorry to have cost you some inconvenience’‘However, it is important to resolve the issue’‘This subject is really too big’‘It doesn't matter’‘However, it is important to resolve the issue’‘Therefore, in the plan...’

在商务英语中，处理产品索赔时，如果货物给对方造成不便，可以通过计算合同总额的10%来要求赔偿。例如，'After calculating, you should compensate us by 10% of the total amount of the contract'。然而，如果对方认为这不合理，可以提出重新讨论。'But we really think it is not reasonable. Could we discuss it for another time?'。在此情况下，可以保留提出索赔的权利。'This been the case, we are compared to reserve the right to lodge a complaint against you'。如果对方表示遗憾，可以请求经理进行协商。'I'm sorry to hear that. I think I should be back to ask my manager for settlement'。在另一个例子中，如果订单的货物重量与合同不符，需要提出索赔。'The weight of our ordered goods is not in conformity with the contract. We must therefore lodge a claim against you'。索赔（claim）与抱怨（complain）类似，但索赔通常指索要赔偿。'We agree to accept your claim'。一旦问题清楚，希望对方能迅速处理。'Everything is clear now. And we hope you will make a prompt settlement'。对于给对方带来的不便，表示歉意。'We are sorry to have cost you so much inconvenience'。接下来，我们将分析实际对话，例如Alice和Anderson之间的对话，了解索赔的严肃性和处理方式。
当客户向你提出索赔时，千万不要直接离开，不再讨论。这样我们的生意也无法长久进行。
本节课到此结束，感谢大家的参与。
